newsitem.title: USA: Horizon Bancorp to buy Beckley Bancorp.
newsitem.headline: Horizon Bancorp to buy Beckley Bancorp.

text.p: Horizon Bancorp Inc said Monday it has an agreement to buy Beckley Bancorp Inc in a deal valued at $16.9 million.
The company said the deal calls for Horizon's HB Acquisition Co unit to pay $25.64 per share for Beckley's outstanding common stock.
The plan further calls for Beckley to merge operations with another Horizon unit, the Bank of Raleigh, the company said.
The deal, subject to shareholder and regulatory approval, is expected to close in the third quarter, Horizon said.
Horizon operates five banks with 21 offices in West Virginia, it said. It has assets totaling $942.8 million.
Beckley operates one bank with two offices in Raleigh County, W.Va.
